Execution Playbooks
Step-by-step guides built from real client work. No theory. No fluff. Just the exact steps, tools, and frameworks used inside ManasFlow. Pick the one that matches what you're shipping this week.
FIRE for CEOs: The AI Adoption Playbook
April 2026
10-step guide for CEOs who want their team to ship AI without a 6-month strategy. Based on 23 company engagements. Fail fast, iterate, run, evolve.
FIRE for Engineers: The Trust-Building Playbook
April 2026
10 lessons for engineers embedded in AI-first teams. How to earn freedom, ship ugly, demo instead of present, and speak results not architecture.
The CEO-Engineer Bridge: Communication Playbook
April 2026
10 frameworks for making CEO-engineer collaboration actually work. Daily updates, guardrails vs instructions, when to hire and when to embed.
Clean-Build-Run: The Automation Framework
March 2026
30 posts distilled into a step-by-step automation framework. Clean your processes first, build the right systems, then let them run. From audit to autopilot.
Claude Code: From Zero to Operating System
March 2026
30-day progression from first install to running your entire business from a terminal. Skills, hooks, MCP servers, agents, and the second brain architecture.
